# META
~~~ini
description=Static scalar result types come from admitted operator/function signatures, not the computed value: Natural addition/multiplication remain valid while Integer subtraction, references and calls cannot silently narrow to Natural. Feature values: KerML 8.4.4.11.
type=file
libraries=standard
require_complete_publication=true
~~~
# SOURCE
~~~sysml
package StaticValues {
    private import ScalarValues::*;
    attribute literal : Natural = 11;
    attribute added : Natural = 11 + 1;
    attribute multiplied : Natural = 11 * 2;
    attribute difference : Natural = 11 - 1;
    attribute integerValue : Integer = 11;
    attribute narrowedReference : Natural = integerValue;
    attribute widening : Real = 11 - 1;
    calc def Identity { in x : Integer; return : Integer = x; }
    attribute narrowedCall : Natural = Identity(11);
    attribute naturalSum : Natural = literal + multiplied;
    attribute def Counted { attribute count : Natural; }
    attribute c : Counted { :>> count = 11 - 1; }
    attribute validC : Counted { :>> count = 11 + 1; }
    attribute declaredDefault : Natural default = 11 - 1;
    item nonempty [1..*];
    attribute positiveSize : Positive = SequenceFunctions::size(nonempty);
    attribute index : Positive = 1;
    attribute nextIndex : Positive = index + 1;
    attribute positiveProduct : Positive = index * index;
    attribute zeroProduct : Natural = index * 0;
}
~~~
